articles.title: Letters: Heron Avenue Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the tool library in the budget. Many of us on Heron Avenue use it every week.
To the editor: I have lived on Heron Avenue for 30 years, and I want to say what a difference the Lower Millrace Improvement Group has made.
Ida Lacey, Lower Millrace

body: To the editor: I have lived on Linden Court for 29 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Library branch has made.

I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting.
Stella Gilroy, Upper Commons
